description: Resolve or verify bounded caller-asserted temporal assertions. Results describe the supplied metadata; this tool does not authenticate sources or enforce native-store sanctuary access.

assertions.description: Caller-asserted records with record_id, source_id, subject, predicate, value, valid_from, valid_until, recorded_at, supersedes; exclude when request_json is supplied

attest.description: Return an unsigned SHA-256 digest binding the operation, exact request bytes and result; not a signature or CPR receipt

mode.description: Contract operation: resolve assertions into facts/citations or verify a candidate proposal (default: resolve)

proposal.description: Candidate proposal object (for verify mode) with status and claims array

question.description: Question object with question_id, query, subject, predicate, valid_at (array of dates), and known_at cutoff

request_json.description: Full raw request JSON; mutually exclusive with assertions, question and proposal

name: sutra.contract
title: Catuṣkoṭi Answer Contract
